name: autoflow
description: Session-end auto-flow gate: on Stop, prompt /record once, then loop /condukt until pending tasks are cleared (auto up to 4×, ask user from 5× onward). Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key). v0.1.8: pid_alive() (used by backlog_driver_active()) no longer always reports dead on Windows — Unix now calls libc::kill(pid,0) directly (no subprocess), Windows uses windows-sys OpenProcess/CloseHandle instead of the non-existent `kill -0`.
